kelleran-beq--the-sabered-hand.text: When Played: Search the top 7 cards of your deck for a unit, reveal it, and play it. It costs 3 resources less. (Put the other cards on the bottom of your deck in a random order.)

old-daka--oldest-and-wisest.text: When Played: You may defeat a friendly Night unit not named Old Daka. Then, you may play that unit from your discard pile for free.

salvage.text: Play a Vehicle unit from your discard pile (paying its cost). Then, deal 1 damage to it.
salvage.rules: Abilities that let you play a card require you to pay that card’s cost unless specified otherwise.

mastery.text: This upgrade costs 1 resource less to play on a <uq> unit.

gnk-power-droid.text: On Attack: The next unit you play this phase costs 1 resource less.
gnk-power-droid.rules: The cost discount from CNK Power Droid's “On Attack” ability remains active even if it is defeated before you play another unit.

honor-bound-partisan.text:
When Played: Deal 1 damage to a base.
When Defeated: The next unit you play this phase costs 1 resource less.

neel--the-cutest-boy.text: When Played/On Attack: The next unit you play this phase with 1 or less power enters play ready.
neel--the-cutest-boy.rules:
(ERRATA) When Played/On Attack: The next unit you play this phase with 1 or less printed power enters play ready.
Once Neel's “When Played/On Attack” ability resolves, it remains active even if it is defeated before you play your next unit with 1 or less printed power.

director-krennic--on-the-verge-of-greatn.text:
Shielded 
The first unit you play each round that has a “When Defeated” ability costs 1 resource less.

admiral-piett--commanding-the-armada.text: Action [Exhaust]: Play a Capital Ship unit from your hand. It costs 1 resource less.
admiral-piett--commanding-the-armada.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
admiral-piett--commanding-the-armada.deployBox: Each Capital Ship unit you play costs 2 resources less.

data-vault.text: Your minimum deck size is increased by 10 cards.

colossus.text: Draw 1 less card in your starting hand.
colossus.rules: If you choose to mulligan your hand, you still draw 1 less card in your mulligan hand.
